author: DaiqingChen
body:
Checked all gene product from extracellular matrix (GO:0031012) from AmiGO 2026/10/20, found 80 genes not in the new version of MatrisomeList. Among those 80 genes, 20 have been reviewed to remove (17) or keep (3) in #6643 .

The remaining 60 genes were originally annotated to the extracellular matrix (GO:0031012) before our curation started. 

- 5 of them are gene products from previous version of Matrisome List, highlighted as green, and the reason of removal noted in the "note" column. 
- 11 of them are potential matrisome gene products (not including the 3 from #6643), highlighted as yellow, and the reason of being potential matrisome gene product noted in the "note" column.
- 8 of them are transmembrane or not functional, noted in "decision_DC" as remove
- The 36 remaining gene products need further investigation to decide @Matrisome 

The list of 60 genes not covered gene products attached here:
[261102_rm_FromECM_list_GitHub.xlsx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34294965/261102_rm_FromECM_list_GitHub.xlsx)
title: Remove gene product from extracellular matrix (GO:0031012)
